parameters.name: AutoReissue
parameters.description:
Whether to enable automatic management.

- enable: enabled

- disable: disabled

parameters.name: CertificateName
parameters.description: The name of the instance. When issuing a certificate, this value serves as the default certificate name.

parameters.name: City
parameters.description: The city where the company or organization of the certificate requester is located. Required when generating a CSR for a DV certificate. Default value: Beijing.

parameters.name: CompanyId
parameters.description: The company information ID. Required for OV and EV certificates. Otherwise, you cannot call ApplyCertificate to request a certificate.

parameters.name: ContactIdList
parameters.description: The list of contact IDs. You must specify at least one contact. Otherwise, you cannot call ApplyCertificate to request a certificate.

parameters.name: CountryCode
parameters.description: The country or region code of the certificate organization. For example, CN represents China, and US represents the United States. Required when generating a CSR for a DV certificate. Default value: CN.

parameters.name: Csr
parameters.description: The CSR content. You can generate a CSR using OpenSSL or Keytool. For more information, see [How to create a CSR file](~~42218~~).

parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description:
The domain name to bind to the certificate. Requirements are as follows:

- Supports single domain names or wildcard domain names (for example, `*.aliyundoc.com`).

- Supports multiple domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). The first domain determines whether a free domain is included.

><notice>

If you bind multiple domain names to the certificate, this parameter is required. This parameter and the **Csr** parameter cannot both be empty. If you set both parameters, the system uses the **CN** field value from the **Csr** as the domain name for the certificate.

></notice>

parameters.name: GenerateCsrMethod
parameters.description:
The CSR generation method. Default value: online.

- online: The system generates the CSR. The Csr field is ignored.

- upload: You upload the CSR. The Csr field is required.

parameters.name: KeyAlgorithm
parameters.description:
The certificate algorithm. Default value: RSA\_2048.

- **RSA\_2048**

- **RSA\_3072**

- **RSA\_4096**

- **ECC\_256**

- **SM2**

parameters.name: Province
parameters.description: The province or region where the company is located. Required when generating a CSR for a DV certificate. Default value: Beijing.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs.

sub_parameters.name: TagKey
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the instance. Valid values for N: **1** to **20**. If you specify this value, it cannot be an empty string.

It can contain up to 64 characters. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and it cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: TagValue
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the instance. Valid values for N: **1** to **20**. If you specify this value, it can be an empty string.

It can contain up to 128 characters. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and it cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: ValidationMethod
parameters.description:
The certificate validation method.

- DNS: DNS validation using TXT or CNAME records.

- HTTP: File-based validation.
